response.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT SupportRepId) AS avg_customers_per_rep FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Only reps who actually have at least one assigned customer are counted in the average; customers with no support rep are excluded. Division is done as a real number so the result is not rounded or truncated.
Support reps who have no customers (employees not referenced in Customer.SupportRepId) are not counted as 'support reps'.

alternatives.interpretation: Average over all employees in the Employee table, including those with zero customers (treating every employee as a potential support rep).
alternatives.sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee) AS avg_customers_per_employee
